title: Left exact functors preserve cohomology when cycles and boundaries are injective
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], let $C^\bullet$ be a bounded-below complex in $\mathcal A$, and define $Z^q(C)=\ker(d_C^q)$, $B^q(C)=\operatorname{im}(d_C^{q-1})$, and $H^q(C)=Z^q(C)/B^q(C)$. Suppose every $Z^q(C)$ and $B^q(C)$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For every left exact additive functor $G:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], the canonical comparison induced by the maps on cycles and quotients is an isomorphism $H^q(G(C^\bullet))\cong G(H^q(C^\bullet))$ for every $q$.

source.place: Lemma 015I (lemma-cartan-eilenberg), using the split short exact sequences from injectivity

proof.text: Fix $q$. In the abelian category $\mathcal A$ there are short exact sequences $0\to B^q(C)\to Z^q(C)\to H^q(C)\to 0$ and $0\to Z^q(C)\to C^q\to B^{q+1}(C)\to 0$. The second sequence splits because its subobject $Z^q(C)$ is injective, and the first splits because its subobject $B^q(C)$ is injective: apply the defining extension property of an injective object to the relevant monomorphism. Thus both sequences are split exact.

source.place: Lemma 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor), proof: computation of the second spectral sequence, where injective cycles, boundaries, and cohomology split the differentials

proof.text: Apply the additive left exact functor $G$ to these split exact sequences. Additivity preserves the chosen retractions and sections, while left exactness identifies $\ker(G(C^q)\to G(C^{q+1}))$ with $G(Z^q(C))$, since $d_C^q$ factors as $C^q\to B^{q+1}(C)\hookrightarrow C^{q+1}$ with a monomorphism second factor. Consequently, $G(d_C^{q-1})$ factoring as the split epimorphism $G(C^{q-1})\to G(B^q(C))$ followed by the split monomorphism $G(B^q(C))\to G(C^q)$, the image of $G(C^{q-1})\to G(C^q)$ is $G(B^q(C))$, and the sequence $0\to G(B^q(C))\to G(Z^q(C))\to G(H^q(C))\to 0$ is split exact.

source.place: Lemma 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor), proof: computation of the second spectral sequence after applying the left exact functor

proof.text: By the identifications in Step 2, $H^q(G(C^\bullet))$ is the quotient $G(Z^q(C))/G(B^q(C))$, and the split exact sequence there identifies this quotient canonically with $G(H^q(C))$. The resulting map is exactly the comparison induced by the maps on cycles and quotients, so it is an isomorphism for every $q$.

lean.statement: theorem cartanEilenberg_leftExact_cohomology {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] [Abelian A] [Abelian B] (C : CochainComplex A ℤ) (hbounded : ∃ n : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < n → IsZero (C.X q)) (hcycles : ∀ q : ℤ, Injective (C.cycles q)) (hboundaries : ∀ q : ℤ, Injective (image (C.d (q - 1) q))) (G : A ⥤ B) [G.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits G] : ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ φ : ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C).homology q ≅ G.obj (C.homology q), ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C).liftCycles (G.map (C.iCycles q)) (q + 1) (by simp) (by simp [← G.map_comp]) ≫ ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj C).homologyπ q ≫ φ.hom = G.map (C.homologyπ q)
